workflows.title: Service startup, health, and process lifetime
agent_tools: No agent/model is called by health
permissions: No health or app-wide session/role dependency; CORSMiddleware is not authentication.
Services retrieves application-state collaborators, not caller identity; domain error mappings are not authorization.
Azure process credentials do not authorize an individual caller.
state_changes: Process: main:app delegates to the factory, which builds or accepts AdminServices and mounts 11 router objects from 10 modules without prefix rewriting.
Process: validated settings and lazy clients are cached; current bootstrap reads only backend .env with process precedence and PYTHON_DOTENV_DISABLED support, not APP_ENV profiles.
Process: lifespan starts optional EvaluationService.run_periodic and cancels/awaits it in finally; evaluator resolution caches are per service instance.
Storage: health itself performs no readiness probes or writes.
success: GET /api/dashboard/health retains its fixed liveness object; 43 explicit handler registrations preserve method/path/name/order after package extraction.
Eight framework GET/HEAD registrations on /api/dashboard/docs, /api/dashboard/openapi.json, /docs/oauth2-redirect and /redoc remain separate from explicit handlers.
failure_retry: Invalid required settings can prevent factory construction/startup; evaluation settings are startup-required only when EVAL_ENABLED is true.
Health success does not validate Azure access, storage, models or jobs.
Lifespan finally now covers exceptional exits but is not a durable worker registry or comprehensive client shutdown.
Existing flat-layout guides may be stale; canonical handlers and source refs here use current routers/core/services/integrations/schemas, never entry-point aliases.

workflows.title: Browser navigation and session synchronization
permissions: App routes are not guarded; DashboardView consumes the user label rather than enforcing the hook's authentication result.
Browser roles, BYPASS_AUTH=false, VITE_SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL and cookies are not admin API authorization.
Optional main assignment controls combine JWT identity and a legacy profile read in a browser precheck; actual main mutation dependencies enforce active-user/role rules.
state_changes: Browser: navigation replaces history; sidebar state and avatar are local.
Browser: ekalaiva.user.v1 persists identity/role; optional temporary-user helpers use ekalaiva.temp.userId.
Browser/process: auth synchronization markers and dashboard GET caches are local, not a server session boundary.
success: Four screen routes render DashboardView; catch-all redirects to /overview.
Relative main GET /auth/me plus admin GET /api/user/{user_id} can synchronize the user label.
No backend handler is owned by this UI-only navigation workflow; the admin profile read belongs to admin-user-directory.
failure_retry: Persisted registration can skip synchronization; errors are not used to deny the screen.
The included production nginx config has no /auth proxy; deployed auth routing is unverified.
Retained registration helper calls admin PUT /api/user/{user_id}, which is not mounted; normal profile 404 is treated as a backend error.
Login/logout/retry hook functions exist but have no controls in the mounted shell.
workflows.implementation_scope: Standalone admin browser shell only; main auth and separately mapped admin profile reads are dependencies, not owned handlers.

workflows.title: All-course reporting, period filters, and usage drill-downs
permissions: Admin analytics reads have no caller/session/role enforcement.
Backend data filtering excludes specific staff role values; it is not authorization or anonymization.
state_changes: Storage: read agents_v1, users_v1, invited_users_v1, chat_threads_v1 and chat_messages_v1, including __token_usage__:{agent_id} partitions.
Process: selected aggregate helpers use a 30-second, 128-entry single-flight cache.
Browser: two-second authenticated user/role/path GET reuse, column sorting, date filters, chart/dialog/search state.
success: Current UI uses Cosmos token events per course, falling back to assistant-message metadata only for courses without events.
Today/week/month/custom reporting, searchable course-token distribution, and per-student token/round charts are wired.
Explicit institute/department course placement determines courseAffiliations; staff affiliations do not place courses.
Missing student attribution is displayed as unavailable; usage is not mastery or roster membership.
failure_retry: Period errors clear data and offer Retry; table errors require remount/reload and student dialogs can be reopened.
Failed loads are not cached; aggregate cache waiters time out after 60 seconds and account changes invalidate/reject browser responses.
Server date strings are inclusive prefix comparisons without typed range-order validation.
Total-user denominators use top-level pairs/email deduplication, not every affiliation or per-TA saved roster; course active counts can repeat a user.
Many admin exceptions remain 500 responses containing exception text; no blanket sanitized-error guarantee.

workflows.title: Compatibility Foundry response totals
permissions: No caller, course membership, or student-role scope on the admin route.
Direct Foundry read uses process credentials and configured AZURE_AI_PROJECT_ENDPOINT.
state_changes: Remote: read stored Foundry response pages, not Cosmos usage events.
Process: aggregate cache is refreshed at a 600-second TTL.
success: GET /api/dashboard/overview/tokens aggregates input/output/total tokens, responses and conversations by agent_reference or historical agent field.
Current OverviewContent does not call the retained getTokenUsageOverview helper.
failure_retry: Pagination caps at 50 pages of 100 responses.
Page failures can yield cached partial results; initial failures return a prior cache or empty object.
A later expired-cache read retries; no automatic full-scan recovery or UI action is wired.

workflows.title: Course selection, legacy progress, and student topic details
permissions: No caller role, course membership, or own-student authorization in standalone admin reads.
Paired UI placement filters and Graph Memory availability checks are not request authorization.
state_changes: Storage: read legacy learning_states_v1, course metadata, user profiles, chat threads and messages.
Browser: institution/department changes clear child selections and hide chat; course request-generation checks reject stale results.
Process: overview/activity queries use summary cache.
success: Selected agent ID is sent in the agent_name path position.
Activity, completion distribution, struggle topics and expandable topic-status rows are shown.
Graph Memory shadow/authoritative suppresses legacy progress reads and returns unavailable metadata; overview badges distinguish this from usage.
failure_retry: Individual missing/unreadable state can return 404; empty legacy state is distinct from measured learning.
Analytics renderer does not fully represent the unavailable/null Graph Memory response.
Errors appear in the shared banner; reselecting/reopening retries.
Course changes invalidate stale details, but same-course student row races are not comprehensively guarded.

workflows.title: Shared image allowance settings
permissions: No server administrator/session check or revision precondition for shared admin quota writes.
Main image generation enforcement is separate from this settings editor.
state_changes: Storage: merge medium/low limits into learning_states_v1 document __image_quota_config__, partition __config__, with updatedAt.
Browser: editable limits and cost preview; Reset restores the loaded snapshot.
success: GET/PUT /api/dashboard/image-quota reads/changes the per-student per-course weekly allowance.
At least one integer field is required; API bounds are 0 through 1000.
Server cost constants and 4.3-week estimates are previews, not live billing prices.
failure_retry: Unreadable/missing stored config silently falls back to medium=5 and low=15.
400/422 validation or 500 storage errors are shown; failed saves retain draft for explicit retry.
Failed initial load can retain a Loading label beside the error.
No concurrency resolution, automatic mutation retry, or quota-reset scheduler is implemented in admin.

workflows.title: Directory reads, affiliation-aware grouping, and profile lookup
permissions: No session/role enforcement on admin directory or profile reads.
Optional course-group reads use verified main assignment access; cosmetic isAdmin/isSuperAdmin remain true.
Names, emails, roles and affiliations are not pseudonymized.
state_changes: Storage: read C1 invited_users_v1 and C2 users_v1; exclude promoted invites and prefer C2 for duplicate email in unfiltered status lists.
Browser: USER_DIRECTORY, search/role/institute/department filters, collapse states and canonical affiliation-aware grouping.
Browser: optional four-loader membership snapshot uses admin teacher lists and main rosters; grouping never writes memberships.
success: GET /api/directory supports role/status; GET /api/user/{user_id} reads the C2 profile.
Complete saved affiliation pairs produce repeated display rows without identity or active-role changes; counts deduplicate canonical users.
Only courses explicitly placed in a pair appear there; failed membership loads leave users visible without falsely labeling them unassigned.
failure_retry: Per-store list failures are swallowed and can return partial/empty HTTP success; profile absence/storage failure can return 404.
Users without any complete institute/department pair do not enter the grouped tree.
Directory request errors require remount/reload; membership errors have Retry course assignments.
Stale membership requests are aborted; storage completeness and account isolation are not guaranteed by frontend caching.

workflows.title: Invitations, CSV imports, and optional additive course assignment
actors: Active main administrator for optional assignment/user CSV import
agent_tools: Main agent_membership.add_member contract; no email/model worker
permissions: Admin POST /api/directory has no caller authorization and uses string fields rather than enforcing the UI role/email/pair policy.
User CSV import and TA assignment require exact build flag true and the browser's fresh main active admin/superadmin precheck; single directory-only invite does not.
Main student membership additions require admin; main teacher additions use authenticated course-manager rules, with a narrower admin UI gate.
Main /auth/me checks token identity only and legacy GET /api/user/{user_id} has no caller guard; mutation authorization comes from the main route dependencies, not those probes.
state_changes: Storage: create a C1 allowlist invitation or add a nonduplicate affiliation to existing C1/C2, preserving active pair/role.
Cross-service: optional main POST /api/agents/{agent_id}/members adds one student/teacher without replacing a roster.
Browser: savedUser checkpoint, sequential CSV counters/errors, independent CSV scope selectors and template Blob download/object URL cleanup.
success: New invitation is 201; existing/affiliation-added response is 200 with flags, not email delivery.
User CSV accepts only name,email,role; optional documented header aliases and one-line quoted records are parsed.
Admin rows and no-TA imports remain directory-only; students are uniquely matched to main eligible candidates before membership writes.
failure_retry: Bad headers/column counts/roles/email/quoting/empty input produce explicit import errors; rows continue independently.
Directory save and course assignment are not transactional; assignment failure does not undo the saved user.
Single-user retry reuses savedUser; re-import a failed CSV row to retry explicitly without replacing others' memberships.
Dialog closing/inputs are blocked during mutations; cancelling afterwards discards browser state, not completed writes.
No concurrent-invitation uniqueness guarantee, batch rollback or automatic non-idempotent retry exists.

workflows.title: Editing profiles and roles, and removing directory entries
permissions: No caller authentication, role-transition policy, target-role constraint or protected-superadmin check in the admin handlers.
canEdit/canRemove use hardcoded admin flags; a configured protected email is only a UI restriction.
state_changes: Storage: DirectoryService edits C2 or C1 names/role/top-level pair and synchronizes an existing selected affiliation through the repository adapter.
Storage: removal attempts C2 and same-ID C1 only; chats, agent membership and research are not cascaded.
Browser: update/remove canonical row; decorated adapter writes invalidate process summary cache, but the extracted save_directory_record used by C1 edits still does not invalidate it.
success: PATCH /api/directory/{user_id} returns edited profile fields; DELETE returns deleted ID.
Browser edit merges retained secondary affiliation fields rather than switching the active profile.
failure_retry: Missing targets return 404; inline dialog errors preserve correction/retry opportunity.
Per-store delete errors are swallowed; success after either deletion can mean partial cleanup.
Cancel closes draft/confirmation without a new write; there is no undo, revision check or automatic retry.
Cache clearing is not multi-process or cross-service invalidation.

workflows.title: API-only active-affiliation switching
permissions: No caller authorization or role-transition policy; only C2 existence and index validity are checked.
state_changes: Storage: set C2 activeAffiliation, institute/college, department, affiliation role and updatedAt.
Process: invalidate local summary cache; course memberships are unchanged.
success: POST /api/directory/{user_id}/switch-affiliation with index returns selected context.
Exported switchUserAffiliation has no mounted UI caller; secondary directory grouping alone never switches context.
failure_retry: Missing C2 profile, no affiliations or invalid index returns 400; invited-only C1 users are unsupported.
Storage failures propagate; no revision check, undo or automatic retry.

workflows.title: Institution and department registries, maintenance, and onboarding counts
permissions: All mounted organization maintenance/count routes lack caller authentication and role enforcement.
Local creation/import and hardcoded super-admin controls do not create a server permission boundary.
state_changes: Browser only: Add Institution/Add Department and their CSV modes mutate in-memory extra registries, not persistent org records.
Storage: maintenance individually upserts top-level institute/department matches in C1 and C2; deletion clears fields rather than deleting users.
Saved affiliation arrays, agent placement/membership and research keys are not migrated; old branches may remain.
success: Rename/delete routes return updated/cleared counts including zero matches.
Current dialogs support confirmation/cancel; templates use name or institute,department.
API-only onboarding-progress returns invited/active/total and done from top-level C1/C2 matching.
failure_retry: Required blank strings return 400; partial writes can occur before errors, without ETag or rollback.
UI rename/delete catches log to console rather than consistently showing errors; explicit retry or cancel remains the local recovery.
Onboarding storage errors return zero counts and done=false, not a verifiable empty department.
Local empty groups do not survive reload by themselves and need not appear without users.

workflows.title: Course ownership transfer and teacher-list replacement
permissions: Admin handlers validate target existence/list shape, not caller identity, management rights, target role or active status.
UI teacher/admin selection and disabled owner checkbox are not server authorization.
These admin full-document upserts are not main authenticated additive membership operations.
state_changes: Storage: update agents_v1.createdById/teacherIds/updatedAt; transfer adds the new owner without removing the old owner from teachers.
Storage: teacher replacement deduplicates IDs and retains owner.
Process/browser: local summary and successful-mutation dashboard caches clear; existing rendered views are not comprehensively refetched.
success: Transfer reports new owner; teacher GET resolves names/emails and is_owner; teacher POST reports the replacement IDs.
failure_retry: Missing payload/targets return 400/404; other storage failures propagate.
Teacher load errors alert and close; save/transfer errors alert and retain a retryable dialog.
Cancel makes no new write; no ETag, merge handling, automatic retry or cross-service invalidation.
Candidate pickers use in-memory USER_DIRECTORY and do not independently load it; visiting Analytics before Directory can leave choices empty.

workflows.title: Opt-in main-API student roster editor
permissions: Exact VITE_STUDENT_ASSIGNMENTS_ENABLED=true gate plus a browser active admin/superadmin precheck combining main GET /auth/me and GET /api/user/{session.id}.
Main /auth/me verifies cookie-preferred/Bearer JWT identity but not active status or role; legacy main GET /api/user/{user_id} has no caller check and can return success with a null profile.
Main roster route dependencies enforce active admin access and ETag concurrency; this is distinct from both probe endpoints and does not secure admin directory reads.
Disabled builds issue no assignment permission/roster requests; failed browser prechecks deny controls and offer retry.
state_changes: Browser: load main roster and admin directory together, retaining selected IDs and revision separately from search/paired affiliation filters.
Main storage: PUT replaces this TA's studentIds only; empty saved roster intentionally removes student access.
Browser: draft/discard dialog, unavailable selections, save/conflict state; close triggers directory membership refresh.
success: Directory or selected Analytics opens saved per-TA assignments; response validation checks IDs, revision and complete candidates.
Active/invited candidates can be assigned; filters and shared links never enroll students.
Select/Clear matching leaves nonmatching selections unchanged.
failure_retry: Failed roster or directory load prevents saving; retry reloads both.
Unavailable selected entries, including filtered-out ones, must be explicitly removed.
Ordinary save errors preserve draft; 409 locks editing until Reload saved roster, which discards unsaved selections.
Switch/close with dirty state prompts discard; saves block closing, and stale reads abort.
Main 401/403/404/422/409/503 remain distinct; prior chats/in-flight responses are not deleted or interrupted by revocation.
workflows.implementation_scope: Standalone admin UI only. Main API handlers and persistence are external contracts, not admin handlers.

workflows.title: Opt-in main-API course placement editor
permissions: Same exact assignment feature flag and browser active-main-admin precheck as roster controls.
The main identity/profile probes do not independently enforce active/admin access; placement route AdminUser dependencies provide that server boundary.
Main placement routes use ETag-preconditioned patches; admin profile/directory permissions are separate.
state_changes: Browser: all-TA selection, directory/course suggestions, exact-name fields, discard and reload state.
Main storage: patch agents_v1 institute and department, clear departmentId; teacher/student membership arrays stay unchanged.
Browser: update courseAffiliations and directory revision, clear dashboard cache and reset invalidated analytics selection.
success: GET supplies saved pair/unassigned and revision; PUT accepts both fields filled or both empty with revision.
Unassigned and other-college TAs remain selectable; successful clearing removes placement only.
failure_retry: Stale reads are aborted/epoch-checked; directory suggestion failure still permits exact free text.
Invalid/mismatched response or main 401/403/404/422/503 becomes visible error.
409 requires reload for a fresh revision, but this UI lacks the roster editor's dedicated conflict lock.
Reload discards draft; dirty switch/close prompts discard; saving prevents closing; no automatic write retry or undo.
workflows.implementation_scope: Standalone admin UI only. Placement GET/PUT are owned by main API and are not counted as admin handlers.

workflows.title: Analytics chat, local tools, and message artifacts
agent_tools: LOGGING_AGENT_NAME at AZURE_AI_PROJECT_ENDPOINT; remote model/definition unverified
permissions: No admin session, course scope or conversation-ownership check.
Selected UI filters enable Ask Agent but are not passed as enforced scope in the text/conversation payload.
Name guard replaces current display-name words only; output/tool data is not comprehensively anonymized.
state_changes: Remote: create/reuse Foundry conversation and streamed responses/tool-output follow-ups.
Process: cached credential/clients; local tools read Cosmos only.
Browser: component-memory messages/conversation ID, abort controller, Markdown/copy/scroll state; no persisted admin chat history.
success: POST stream accepts text and conversation_id or thread_id alias; explicit OPTIONS handler is also mounted.
SSE carries ID, text/message-block events, done/error; plain text has fallback formatting.
Sanitized Markdown/math/tables/code, clipboard copying, HTTP(S) links and lazy browser images are supported.
Unknown tool names receive acknowledgement only; remote model/tools are not inferred from branding.
failure_retry: Empty text is 400; stream errors are generic Internal error, while tool error text can feed the model.
Malformed SSE JSON is skipped; incremental plus final message blocks can duplicate appended content.
Stop aborts browser fetch, not remote work; Close merely hides the pane.
No wired regeneration, edit, new-chat reset, automatic replay or general tool-round cap.
Thumbs/More buttons have no handlers; no feedback write or asset-generation capability is implied.
Unfiltered list_all_students reads legacy learning-state records in users_v1, unlike per-course learning_states_v1.

workflows.title: Institute and department research jobs and result inspection
agent_tools: INSTITUTE_RESEARCH_AGENT_NAME at PROJECT_ENDPOINT; remote model/tools unverified
permissions: No caller session/admin enforcement; UI super-admin controls are cosmetic.
Process identity may create/write the configured account's institute-research-v2 container.
state_changes: Remote: each ResearchService job creates a Foundry conversation/response using inline profile prompts and optional instructions via the injected response integration.
Storage: overwrite researching/completed/failed/cancelled JSON at institutes/{sanitized_name}.json or departments/{sanitized_institute}/{sanitized_department}.json in institute-research-v2.
Process: response integration now context-manages DefaultAzureCredential/AIProjectClient; response and storage integrations no longer use the optional monorepo credential fallback.
Process: successful research reads/writes still cache indefinitely; background work is not durable.
Browser: bulk status load, per-key 15-second polling, prompt dialog, collapsible result viewer and retry/cancel labels.
success: Bulk/status reads return stored data or not_started; researching suppresses a normal duplicate trigger via already_researching.
Nonempty JSON object parsing/repair produces a completed profile and timing fields, not strict full-schema validation.
View and Re-Research are wired; viewer rerun omits prior instructions.
failure_retry: Blank names/pairs return 400; model/parse failure writes failed when storage succeeds.
Cancel only overwrites a status marker and stops this browser poll; it does not cancel the remote call or worker, which can later overwrite cancelled.
Trigger check and marker save are non-atomic; sanitized names can collide; process restart has no durable resume.
Blob read failures look like not_started and ignored save=False can acknowledge nondurable work.
Polling ignores errors, stops normally only on completed/failed, and may not notice cancellation by another client.
No TTL/multi-process cache coherence; viewer rerun has no explicit rejection handler; retry is manual.

workflows.title: Feedback review and attachment delivery
permissions: No session, administrator, feedback-owner or attachment-owner check.
Proxy validates HTTPS, exact configured storage hostname, feedback-attachments container prefix and no .. path segment; these are not caller authorization.
state_changes: Storage: read feedback_v1 and configured-account Blob attachments, without submission/upload/deletion.

Process: extracted AttachmentService resolves the URL and download_attachment now context-manages credential/blob clients; proxy still buffers content and returns streaming bytes with public one-day cache headers.
Browser: category/sentiment filters, attachment list, image/PDF overlay or other-file new tab.
success: GET feedback returns stored sentiment/category, text, names/emails and URLs; current UI asks limit=500.
Attachment proxy serves stored content type/length; image/PDF preview and other-file viewing/download are wired.
failure_retry: Helper max_item_count is a page size while iteration exhausts pages, not a guaranteed overall record limit.
Cosmos exceptions can be swallowed into empty feedback/stats; HTTP failures show an error view with remount/reload recovery.
Bad URL/path returns 400; Blob errors become 500 with exception detail.
No explicit viewer load-retry/cancel API or general admin asset-library/storage browser exists.

workflows.title: API-only on-demand groundedness and RAG judging
agent_tools: Azure GroundednessEvaluator SDK path (declared runtime dependency; execution unverified)
permissions: No admin caller/session/scope authorization.
Evaluation configuration is required by helper import even if the scheduled evaluator is disabled.
state_changes: Remote: optional Search read and model/SDK judging incur usage.
Process: blocking evaluation runs through asyncio.to_thread; batch rows are sequential.
Storage: on-demand endpoints do not save evaluation records or learner mastery.
success: Single/batch groundedness supports method convention sdk/llm/auto; auto or other strings fall through to SDK-to-LLM fallback.
Combined RAG uses three LLM judges and averages non-null metrics.
Results concern prompt-truncated context/response and intended 1-5 scores, not strict score-schema or learning validation.
failure_retry: Single groundedness without context returns error/null inside ok=true; RAG without context returns 400.
Empty batch is 400; individual batch errors retain ok=false results and other rows continue.
SDK exceptions trigger auto fallback; partial combined failures become null metric scores/reasons.
Other errors can return 500/detail; no automatic transient retry, persisted request job, idempotency or cancellation route.

workflows.title: Stored evaluation reads and the dormant quality panel
actors: Analytics operator viewing the placeholder panel
permissions: No caller/session/owner/course authorization on stored evaluation reads.
Returned records can include query/response/context, retrieved content and user/session references.
state_changes: Storage: read single document/session partition, session list, thread list or declared cross-partition all route.
Browser: current fetchGroundedness is no-op; evaluations/summary remain empty/null and Refresh issues no request.
Compatibility renderer retains expansion and Show all/less state, not a currently loaded dataset.
success: Declared result handlers return stored records, averages and all-route score distribution when reached.
This inventory includes the decorated get_all_groundedness handler without falsely claiming current UI use or reachability.
failure_retry: GET /groundedness/{message_group_id} precedes /groundedness/all; normal route order shadows the latter and /all without session_id validates against the earlier handler.
Single missing/unreadable record yields 404; list storage failures can become empty results.
No groundedness evaluations yet in current UI is not evidence that stored data is absent.
No active UI retry/load, rejudge or deletion contract; direct clients choose whether to retry.

workflows.title: Manual stored evaluations and the optional scheduled evaluator
agent_tools: AZURE_EVAL_MODEL direct model judges and semantic Search
permissions: Manual trigger has no caller authorization; scheduled work uses process credentials across users/courses.
EVAL_ENABLED defaults false; configuration, not an admin UI control, enables scheduled work.
state_changes: Process: sleep/scan loop defaults to 5-second interval, 24-hour lookback and 50-item batch; thread/course-session resolution caches now belong to the injected EvaluationService instance.
Storage: read message groups and re-retrieve context; upsert groundedness_evaluations_v1 with messageGroupId ID and sessionId partition.
Remote: three LLM metrics incur model/Search usage; stored method argument does not switch this path to SDK judging.
success: Manual trigger requires messageGroupId/sessionId/threadId/userId and returns the stored evaluation.
Scheduled discovery fetches twice the batch limit, excludes/deduplicates evaluated groups, then processes the bounded batch.
Stored records include limited query/response/context, chunks, scores/reasons/claims and time, not learner mastery updates.
failure_retry: Missing manual fields return 400; intended 422 on no result is caught by the broad handler except and becomes 500.
No session/context can lead to placeholder context, and null metric records can still be stored and skipped next cycle.

Per-item errors log; unevaluated records may be retried next scan; unexpected outer errors back off 30 seconds. Thread-resolution exceptions now log, although adapter failures may still collapse to empty values.
No durable scheduled job, resume ledger, distributed lock, exactly-once guarantee or automatic rejudge; manual calls may overwrite.
Lifespan finally cancels/awaits coroutine even on exceptional exits but cannot guarantee cancellation of a blocking worker thread or remote call.

ui_routes.screen: DashboardView analytics, selected course and optional chat/dialogs

ui_routes.note: Includes / and unknown paths; no separate root or dev-only route is declared.

ui_actions.title: Navigate dashboard screens and expand/collapse sidebar
ui_actions.condition: always
ui_actions.behavior: History-replacing navigation and local sidebar/avatar state; no route authorization.

ui_actions.title: Synchronize the shell's session label and profile
ui_actions.condition: Shell mount when hook synchronization is not already satisfied/skipped
ui_actions.behavior: Relative /auth development proxy is separate from API_BASE_URL. Retained profile PUT helper is unmounted and is not a supported provisioning action; no login/logout controls are mounted.

ui_actions.title: Load and sort all-course usage and totals
ui_actions.condition: /overview
ui_actions.behavior: Column sorting and Graph Memory availability badges are local; failure is an error view, not zero totals.

ui_actions.title: Choose Today, This Week, This Month or Custom dates and retry period statistics
ui_actions.condition: /overview
ui_actions.behavior: Uses start_date/end_date query parameters; Custom Go submits explicitly. Error clears cards to unavailable and exposes Retry.

ui_actions.title: Inspect and search Token Usage by Course
ui_actions.condition: Total Tokens card after overview load
ui_actions.behavior: Opens positive-token course rows from existing data; search does not change original share denominator; closing has no persistence.

ui_actions.title: Open per-student token and round charts
ui_actions.condition: Average token/round cell for a loaded overview course
ui_actions.behavior: Sends agent_id; dialogs distinguish loading, error and empty data, and show local chart tooltips. Reopening retries.

ui_actions.title: Edit shared medium/low allowance, preview costs, save or reset draft
ui_actions.condition: /overview after successful overview load
ui_actions.behavior: Save changes shared config; Reset is local. Failed saves preserve inputs; no role gate or version merge.

ui_actions.title: Load course choices and select institution, department and TA
ui_actions.condition: /analytics; agent list also loads on DashboardView mount
ui_actions.behavior: Parent filters clear child selections/data; course ID fills agent_name; explicit paired placement filter prevents all-course fallback.

ui_actions.title: Expand/collapse a student's topic breakdown
ui_actions.condition: Selected analytics course with legacy student summaries
ui_actions.behavior: Read-only topic groups; collapse clears local detail, reopening reloads and failures use shared error banner.

ui_actions.title: Load, search and filter the affiliation-aware directory tree
ui_actions.condition: /user-directory
ui_actions.behavior: Role/institute/department/search and group expansion preserve canonical users and active affiliation; complete affiliation pairs drive branches.

ui_actions.title: Read and retry per-course teacher/student grouping
ui_actions.condition: VITE_STUDENT_ASSIGNMENTS_ENABLED === 'true' and fresh main active admin/superadmin permission
ui_actions.behavior: Four bounded browser loaders, abort on invalidation; assignments-unavailable keeps users visible; Retry reloads without mutating rosters.

ui_actions.title: Add a directory user with optional course assignment and assignment-only retry
ui_actions.condition: Directory invite always available under cosmetic admin flags; main targets only for optional TA selection with verified access
ui_actions.behavior: Require email/institute/department in UI; preserve savedUser after partial success; student candidate lookup only for student role, admin remains directory-only.

ui_actions.title: Import user CSV into dedicated college/department with optional TA
ui_actions.condition: Exact assignment flag true and verified main active admin/superadmin, including no-TA user imports
ui_actions.behavior: Only name,email,role; one line per record, per-row counters/errors; no TA means no main membership write. Re-import failed assignment row explicitly; no rollback.

ui_actions.title: Preview and download user, institution and department CSV templates
ui_actions.condition: Corresponding Add dialog's View Template
ui_actions.behavior: Creates a local CSV Blob/object URL, downloads and revokes URL; no server template asset or record upload occurs during preview.

ui_actions.title: Edit canonical name, role and active affiliation fields
ui_actions.condition: User row Edit; canEdit currently grants cosmetic super-admin privileges
ui_actions.behavior: Save updates directory; Cancel discards local draft, inline failure allows correction/retry; no server role-transition check.

ui_actions.title: Confirm or cancel directory-user removal
ui_actions.condition: User row Remove except configured cosmetic protected email
ui_actions.behavior: Successful UI removal is not a membership/chat cascade; errors stay in confirmation. Server has no corresponding protected-email guard.

ui_actions.title: Add/import local institution and department choices
ui_actions.condition: Directory Add Institution/Add Department under cosmetic admin flags
ui_actions.behavior: Single-entry forms and organization CSV modes populate in-memory extra registries only; page reload loses unattached choices.

ui_actions.title: Rename or confirm deletion of institution/department fields
ui_actions.condition: Directory branch controls under cosmetic super-admin flag
ui_actions.behavior: Blank UI requests disabled; errors log and dialog remains; operations update top-level fields only, not affiliation arrays, placement or research keys.

ui_actions.title: Select and transfer ownership of the analytics TA
ui_actions.condition: Selected analytics course; no verified assignment permission requirement
ui_actions.behavior: Teacher/admin UI choices; success/failure alerts and Cancel. Admin route validates existence only, no version/caller check.

ui_actions.title: Load and replace assigned teachers while retaining owner
ui_actions.condition: Selected analytics course; no verified assignment permission requirement
ui_actions.behavior: Owner checkbox disabled; load failure closes, save failure retains draft. This full replacement is not main additive members.

ui_actions.title: Verify or retry main-API assignment permissions
ui_actions.condition: Directory or Analytics and VITE_STUDENT_ASSIGNMENTS_ENABLED === 'true'
ui_actions.behavior: Browser combines main JWT identity with a legacy unguarded profile read and checks active admin/superadmin; main mutation dependencies, not these probes, enforce authorization. Cookies/no-store and stale-check aborts gate roster, placement, imports and grouping.

ui_actions.title: Open a TA roster and retry loading candidates plus directory
ui_actions.condition: Verified optional assignment access
ui_actions.behavior: Both responses required; malformed/missing candidates or directory failure blocks edits/saving; load aborts on TA switch/unmount.

ui_actions.title: Filter students, select/clear matching and review unavailable selections
ui_actions.condition: Loaded optional roster, not saving or conflict-locked
ui_actions.behavior: Paired affiliation filtering does not enroll or move TA; hidden selections remain; unavailable selected entries block Save, with Clear filters recovery.

ui_actions.title: Save/retry roster replacement, reload saved state or discard draft
ui_actions.condition: Verified optional assignment access and validated loaded roster
ui_actions.behavior: PUT student_ids/revision; empty list explicitly revokes. 409 requires reload; reload discards draft. Dirty switch/close prompts discard; active save blocks closing.

ui_actions.title: Choose any TA and load saved department placement plus suggestions
ui_actions.condition: Verified optional assignment access
ui_actions.behavior: Includes unassigned/out-of-scope TAs; failed suggestions allow exact free text; stale placement GETs abort.

ui_actions.title: Save or clear TA placement, reload saved assignment, keep/discard changes
ui_actions.condition: Verified optional assignment access and saved placement revision
ui_actions.behavior: Both names or neither; membership unchanged. 409 requires fresh revision; reload discards draft; dirty close/switch prompts and saving blocks closing.

ui_actions.title: Open Ask Agent, choose suggestions, send/continue and stop the stream
ui_actions.condition: Analytics institution, department and TA selected to open Ask Agent
ui_actions.behavior: Sends name-guarded text and conversation ID, not enforced selection scope. Stop aborts local fetch; closing hides pane, no remote cancellation or regeneration.

ui_actions.title: Read Markdown artifacts, copy message/code, follow links and scroll
ui_actions.condition: Rendered analytics chat content
ui_actions.behavior: Sanitized Markdown/math/tables/code and lazy images; HTTP(S) links/browser image requests are direct external resources, not admin asset APIs. Copy/scroll are local. Good/Bad/More controls are inert.

ui_actions.title: Load bulk research status and poll active jobs
ui_actions.condition: Loaded directory under cosmetic super-admin flag; interval for researching keys
ui_actions.behavior: One bulk request then 15-second polls; completed/failed ends interval, errors ignored; unmount clears browser timers, not backend tasks.

ui_actions.title: Enter optional research instructions and confirm initial/retry research
ui_actions.condition: Directory institute/department Research or Retry control
ui_actions.behavior: Prompt Cancel sends nothing; confirm sets researching and starts polling. Request failure sets failed; only the configured research agent is invoked.

ui_actions.title: Inspect collapsible research results, close or Re-Research
ui_actions.condition: Directory research result viewer
ui_actions.behavior: GET populates structured sections or error; rerun omits prior instructions, parses viewer title for scope and has no explicit rejection handler.

ui_actions.title: Mark in-progress institute/department research cancelled
ui_actions.condition: Researching status control
ui_actions.behavior: Clears local poll before request and changes saved marker; does not cancel actual worker/Foundry response and can later be overwritten.

ui_actions.title: Load feedback/stats and filter sentiment/category
ui_actions.condition: /feedback
ui_actions.behavior: UI uses limit=500; local filters only; load errors require remount/reload and helper empty results can mask backend storage failure.

ui_actions.title: List attachments, view image/PDF overlays or open another file
ui_actions.condition: Feedback item has saved attachment URLs
ui_actions.behavior: URL query selects a validated configured-account blob; image/PDF use img/iframe, other types open a tab; Close clears browser viewer state only.

ui_actions.title: Show the current RAG Quality placeholder and no-op Refresh
ui_actions.condition: Selected analytics course; fetchGroundedness is deliberately disabled
ui_actions.behavior: No actual evaluation request. Compatibility query/response/claims expansion and Show all/less renderer has no populated data in the mounted app; not evidence of zero evaluations or an automatic evaluator.
